title: A multimodal speech-production dataset with time-aligned articulography EEG audio and vocal-tract anatomy
manual_evidence: Primary EMA/audio production; dataset includes Praat TextGrids for short prompt-response syllable audio, but current public documentation does not establish that those TextGrid boundaries/labels are manually created or exhaustively human-verified. External anthropometry is measured directly; anatomical pharyngometry/rhinometry are primary measurements.
admission_scope: REVIEW until annotation provenance is established; if direct human-measured anatomical variables are admitted as primary derived measurements, isolate those source-faithfully.
notes: ~17 h EMA with matched audio; 29 German adults; 8700 DDK syllable-task trials; 18 have pharyngometry/rhinometry/3D head meshes; raw 1250 Hz EMA and 48 kHz audio; machine-readable metadata and per-participant archives. Canonical DOI 10.48656/6y1s-px92.

title: The Data of Formants of Tibetan Trilingual Learners' English Vowels Production
manual_evidence: Repository description explicitly states acoustic analysis used Praat with careful manual annotation and validation.
admission_scope: Admit supplied formant observations and participant metadata; preserve trajectory samples and peak values separately; do not infer unsupplied segmentation/context.
notes: Public files: Background Information of participants.docx; Tibetan Females.txt; Tibetan Males.txt. Deposit describes F1/F2 trajectories and peak formant values for /aɪ eɪ ɔɪ aʊ oʊ/. Requires file-level parsing next pass.

title: Russian Fricatives
manual_evidence: All first-session target-fricative boundaries were manually inspected and corrected after MAUS preprocessing; second-session Recording_2 remains automatic-only and is excluded.
admission_scope: Admit Recording_1 target-fricative manual boundary layer and public metadata/sentence-list information only; exclude Recording_2 automatic-only boundaries. Do not redistribute restricted files.
notes: 22561 total fricative tokens; 17287 extracted individual fricative WAVs; 198 sentences; 59 first-session speakers plus 18 second sessions. Repository inventory: 1_filter_the_noise.zip; 2_fricative_extraction.zip; Recording_1.zip; Recording_2.zip; metadata.zip; sentence_list.zip. Restricted data contract prohibits redistribution.
